name: Matterport
positioning: The 3D capture standard — a walkable digital twin that doubles as a measurable record of the space.
description: Matterport captures buildings in 3D using dedicated cameras or a phone, producing walkable virtual tours, automatic floor plans, measurements and structured space data hosted on its cloud platform, embeddable in listings and other systems.
real_estate_use: In marketing, a scan lets a remote buyer or tenant walk the space before travelling. In operations it does something less obvious and often more valuable: it is a dated, measurable record of condition. Property managers scan at move-in and move-out to settle deposit disputes; facility teams scan plant rooms so a contractor can measure without a site visit.
features: 3D capture from dedicated cameras or smartphone
Walkable virtual tours embeddable in listings
Automatic floor plan and measurement generation
Dated condition records for inspections and disputes
Space and asset tagging inside the model
API and integrations with listing and management platforms

use_cases.job: Let a remote buyer or tenant walk the property before travelling to see it
Hold a dated, measurable condition record for move-in and move-out disputes
